falseAlarms.what: (i) zones correct: every fragment rendered and declared +00:00, so every advisory is a false alarm

burst.note: the E5 repeat process: 2-3 messages from one sender with one common short body, within 0-5 minutes, anywhere on the timeline; repeatBursts is its count

metrics: false_alarm_rate per (geometry, size, repeatBursts) cell = runs with at least one advisory / runs
advisories per run, and for each advisory: offset, support, supportAtZero, maxControlSupport, distinctKeys

detection.what: (ii) one misdeclared zone: F2 rendered in renderZone and declared as declaredZone; F1 rendered and declared +00:00
detection.pairs: every ordered (renderZone, declaredZone) from zones with renderZone != declaredZone: 56
metrics: detection_rate per pair and per shift (renderZone - declaredZone) = runs with an advisory naming the F1/F2 pair at that shift, with its sign / runs
runs with an advisory at any other offset

reason for each miss, the first that applies, computed with zoneOffsetSupport at the true shift: F1 or F2 has no record with an instant; support < minSupport; distinct keys < minDistinctKeys; support <= support at zero; support <= best control support
